mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place ( place_id, member_id, region_id, place_type, name, description, address, mapx, mapy, is_closed, created_at, updated_at, first_image, hashtags, min_price, use_fee_info, people_count ) VALUES ( #{placeId}, #{memberId}, #{regionId}, #{placeType}, #{name}, #{description}, #{address}, #{mapx}, #{mapy}, #{isClosed}, NOW(), NOW(), #{firstImage}, #{hashtags}, #{minPrice}, #{useFeeInfo}, #{peopleCount} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE region_id = VALUES(region_id), place_type = VALUES(place_type), name = VALUES(name), description = VALUES(description), address = VALUES(address), mapx = VALUES(mapx), mapy = VALUES(mapy), is_closed = VALUES(is_closed), updated_at = NOW(), first_image = VALUES(first_image), hashtags = VALUES(hashtags), min_price = VALUES(min_price), use_fee_info = VALUES(use_fee_info), people_count = VALUES(people_count);
mapper.select: SELECT place_id AS placeId, member_id AS memberId, region_id AS regionId, place_type AS placeType, name, description, address, mapx, mapy, is_closed AS isClosed, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, first_image AS firstImage, hashtags, min_price AS minPrice, use_fee_info AS useFeeInfo, people_count AS peopleCount FROM place WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
